# 三國行旅 Sanguo Travel

> Public Three Kingdoms travel source catalog by 凸肚男. Original passages are Chinese; controls and guidance are bilingual.

## Scope and limitations

34 cities, 6040 source passages/outlines, 2830 candidate place relationships, 15 museum object/site entries and 3404 station names. Mentions do not establish event location or participant roles. Museum entries include later commemorations; verify current display. No live fares or seats. Private journals must not be crawled, requested or published. Site tools return public data or prepare unsaved drafts only.

## Main pages

- [Interactive app](https://sanguo-travel.pages.dev/): city lookup, sources, museum guidance, rail links, local journal.
- [City catalog](https://sanguo-travel.pages.dev/cities): static pages with evidence and caveats.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/TTYTSENG/sanguo-travel): maintenance instructions.

## Provenance

Museum verification date: 2026-10-04. Station compilation date: 2026-10-05. Site update: 2026-10-14. Contact tzesmann@gmail.com. Individual source URLs and limitations are listed on each city page.
## Event evidence and methods

- [Timeline evidence](https://sanguo-travel.pages.dev/timeline-sources): 67 historical events, original citations and separate fictional hints.
- [Methods and provenance](https://sanguo-travel.pages.dev/sources): limitations, source dates and citation guidance.
- [Interactive map](https://sanguo-travel.pages.dev/timeline): 184–280 year-end city nodes; not precise borders.
